lanes.current_read: Automatic non-v10 source-supported waves are promising but still need broader held-out proof and phrase-contract coverage before runtime-quality claims. The wave5 materialized portfolio passes source admission with 51 final admitted rows, 0 leakage rejects, 0 sense rejects, and semantic contract coverage 16 / 16. The former active/shadow blocker `present:002` is now treated as a same-visible-target active case because the source portfolio already contains the current-time noun sense for visible replacement `presente`. A WordNet phrase-control miner adds 7 containment-only rows across 7 / 16 phrase cases, including `end tables placed conveniently` for the former `end:001` no-winner blocker. With that phrase-expanded evidence batch, the frozen wave5 active/shadow and phrase/no-winner held-out suites now both pass at 0 harmful replacements / 0 false abstains. The next breadth screen excluded 43 already-studied triggers and still found 100 candidates. On that fresh list, the supported-source wave6 sweep reaches only 6 / 16 admission-selected families, while the paired forward-only upper-bound sweep reaches 55 / 64 semantic coverage and a 16 / 16 selected control wave. The first conversion audit showed 0 / 16 selected upper-bound families fully supported and only 13 / 38 selected senses already supported. The new Wiktextract translation-table overlay converts that gap: 38 / 38 selected senses and 16 / 16 families are now source-supported, and the generic conversion audit confirms no remaining worklist rows. Rerunning WordNet definition/example evidence on the supported wave gives 61 admitted rows, 0 leakage rejects, and semantic contract 16 / 16. Fresh wave6 held-out validation is now in place: 38 active/shadow rows and 16 phrase/no-winner rows. The narrow guard repair fixes `show sold out` and adjective-nominal `upset`, while temporary wave5 regression checks still pass. Wave6 remains blocked, not promoted: active/shadow has 2 harmful replacements (`leave` absence, game `piece`) and 1 false abstain (`leave` permission); phrase/no-winner has 2 harmful replacements (`bear` animal, equitable `fair`). No tested scalar margin passes both suites, and the existing phrase-control miner only finds `in advance`, not the current blockers.
lanes.next_action: Do not promote yet. Preserve wave5 as a seed-pass lane and use wave6 as the next evidence-repair target: split `leave` permission-vs-absence with better translation-sense evidence, strengthen game-piece shadow evidence, and add alternate-noun/adjective no-winner source coverage for `bear` animal and equitable `fair`. Rerun held-out validation, margin sweep, and failure-class mining after each mechanism-level repair. Keep the 9 remaining wave5 phrase-contract gaps visible and treat the current margin 0 candidate as current-suite evidence only.

The first live aligned-frame run generated 97 rows; strict leakage/duplicate and sense admission kept 36. Merged into the prior 87-row source control, the frozen source-admission ablation improved to 0 harmful / 1 false abstain, but active/shadow held-out v2 still had 1 false abstain. A prompt-process fix added aligned-sentence-frame-v2 diversity frames; the follow-up 5-row board-shadow micro-run admitted 3 rows and made all 19 active/shadow families selector-ready. The source-scope margin bakeoff then showed a stronger way to use source rows: add them to the incumbent definition/example row surface. Combined LLM-v2 plus WordNet-reference additive rows reached 0 harmful / 37 false abstains across four suites, versus 0 / 44 for the no-source row control.
lanes.next_action: Do not promote yet. Treat additive source evidence as the leading research candidate and test companion negative controls, broader heldout, source-family agreement, calibrated aggregation, and additive context selection before a runtime-policy claim.

After live aligned-frame generation plus strict admission, the v2 selector-ready composite has 126 rows and all 19 active/shadow families are selector-ready. The best source-plus-definition selector improved to 0 harmful / 47 false abstains, while pure source-row selectors are 0 / 48. lanes.next_action: Keep the selector machinery as research infrastructure, but do not promote it. Re-test context selection only after additive source evidence, source-family agreement, or calibrated row aggregation has a stronger row surface to select from.

methodology_rules: Do not use a generic done state.
Do not mark a lane swept without a reproducible manifest or generated artifact.
Do not mark a lane promotable from discovery data alone.
Do not collapse source-coverage work, score-surface work, final decision-rule work, and phrase/no-winner work into one metric.
Keep negative controls visible for every candidate family.
Keep phrase/no-winner behavior visible separately from active-vs-shadow scoring.
Record whether the lane changes c, a, similarity, aggregation, final decision, source coverage, phrase handling, or runtime policy.
Production runtime policy remains unchanged until a candidate beats the incumbent on frozen and held-out suites.
